core_obligations: Given standard uniformization/Bers-slice theory, the modular-form/ODE correspondence and Poincare polygon theorem, the source-specific task is to reconstruct a candidate Fuchsian group from Heun-solution data without assuming that this group is the equation monodromy: lift the Klein-four automorphisms, identify fixed-point/cusp representatives, construct the parabolic generators and the normalization r(rho), then use modularity and comparison with a potentially different punctured sphere to force the same uniformizing ratio and accessory value. The geometric-to-analytic reconstruction and reverse identification constitute one non-routine H2 framework. The final uniqueness invocation alone, normalization lemma, matrix identities, divisor-dimension argument and Rankin-Cohen coefficient computations are not additional H2/H3 units. All original assertions remain author responsibility.
